To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a hierarchal pipeline of classifiers performs better than a 1-stage classifier and that a 2-stage classifier performs better than a one-stage classifier.
a hierarchal pipeline outperforms a flat pipeline and that the trade-off between the number of tweets and the F1-measure is a significant consideration for a real world deployment.
(1) a hierarchal pipeline is better than a single classifier, and (2) the F1-measure can be traded off with the number of tweets to be classified.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a pipeline for sentiment analysis.
the following: (1) How to design the classifier for sentiment analysis of tweets? (2) How to trade off the number of tweets used to make a prediction versus the accuracy of the prediction?
the design and analysis of a hierarchal cascade of classifiers for end-to-end sentiment analysis of Twitter data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the best way to classify tweets into Objective, Neutral, Negative or Positive is to use a 3-class hierarchical cascade.

the cascaded design outperforms the 4-way design, and that the F1-score can be improved with the use of a large training set, and a small validation set, with the trade-off being the number of tweets predicted.
our pipeline achieves a better F1-measure on a larger number of tweets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the best way to classify a tweet is to use a 4-way model for the final classification.

we show that the performance of sentiment analysis of Twitter data can be improved significantly by using a hierarchal pipeline of classifiers and that the performance of the pipeline can be improved further by making predictions on a subset of tweets.
we have built a robust end-to-end pipeline to perform sentiment analysis of Twitter data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of sentiment analysis, a hierarchal pipeline is better than a direct 4-way classifier.
the performance of a sentiment analysis system is highly dependent on the design of the classification scheme.
the design of a pipeline is as important as the individual components of the pipeline.
